description: Use this when an adult asks what waist size to aim for at their height for a fitness goal, such as "waist size for 5 ft 8 man", "ideal waist for 160 cm woman" or "what should my waist be". Gives half your height and the suggested Indian range limit. Do not use for children, pregnancy, or medical questions.

height_ft.description: Height feet part, if not using centimetres

height_in.description: Height inches part, used with height_ft

sex.description: Sex, since the suggested ranges differ

name: waist_target
title: Waist size to stay under
